description: Hybrid evolutionary-exact optimization method for the bi-objective design-for-control of water distribution networks is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Joy Ulusoy. This MATLAB dataset contains network properties and problem characteristics for the case study networks - pescara - Net25 - BWFL used to illustrate the optimal WDN valve placement and control problem in the paper titled "Hybrid evolutionary-exact optimization method for the bi-objective design-for-control of water distribution networks" (submitted for publication in Water Resources Research). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
